name: @tandem/shared
description: Generated API types, hand-written Zod schemas and timezone-safe date helpers, shared by `tandem-mobile` and `tandem-web`.

scripts.types-check: npm run generate && git ls-files --error-unmatch src/types/api.ts >/dev/null && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- src/types/api.ts
scripts.verify: npm run types-check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format-check && npm run test
